# Cortexcn

> Cortexcn is a shadcn registry of React and Tailwind CSS components, page blocks, and charts. Items install with the shadcn CLI (`npx shadcn@latest add @cortexcn/<name>`, or `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.cortexcn.dev/r/<name>.json`), which copies the source into the user's project, so there is no runtime package to update. The source lives in `packages/ui` (`@cortexcn/ui`), and the docs site and registry host is `apps/web` (Next.js and Fumadocs), served at https://ui.cortexcn.dev.

Documentation source files live under `apps/web/content/docs/` (MDX). The workspace uses Bun and Turborepo. `bun run registry:build` writes the registry JSON to `apps/web/public/r/`, which is served at `https://ui.cortexcn.dev/r/{name}.json`, with the full index at `https://ui.cortexcn.dev/r/registry.json`. Chart demos are at `/charts/[slug]` and page blocks at `/blocks`.

To use the `@cortexcn/<name>` form, a project adds `"@cortexcn": "https://ui.cortexcn.dev/r/{name}.json"` under `registries` in `components.json`. In a user's project, installed charts are imported from `@/components/charts`; `@cortexcn/ui` is the workspace package used only inside this repo.

For coding agents there is a read-only MCP server at `https://ui.cortexcn.dev/mcp`, agent skills (`npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.cortexcn.dev/r/agent-skills.json`), and a DESIGN.md for the design system (`npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.cortexcn.dev/r/design-md.json`). Setup guides are at https://ui.cortexcn.dev/docs/integration.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](./apps/web/content/docs/index.mdx): Cortexcn is a set of beautifully designed components and a code distribution platform. Works with your favorite React frameworks and AI models. Open Code.
- [Installation](./apps/web/content/docs/installation.mdx): How to install and configure Cortexcn in your project.
- [Theming](./apps/web/content/docs/theming.mdx): Theme your charts using CSS custom properties for consistent, customizable styling.

## Components

- [Components](./apps/web/content/docs/components/index.mdx): Every component you can add to your project from the Cortexcn registry.
- [Accordion](./apps/web/content/docs/components/accordion.mdx): A vertically stacked set of headings that each reveal a section of content.
- [Alert](./apps/web/content/docs/components/alert.mdx): Displays a callout for user attention.
- [Alert Dialog](./apps/web/content/docs/components/alert-dialog.mdx): A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.
- [Aspect Ratio](./apps/web/content/docs/components/aspect-ratio.mdx): Displays content within a desired ratio.
- [Avatar](./apps/web/content/docs/components/avatar.mdx): An image element with a fallback for representing the user.
- [Badge](./apps/web/content/docs/components/badge.mdx): Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.
- [Breadcrumb](./apps/web/content/docs/components/breadcrumb.mdx): Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.
- [Button](./apps/web/content/docs/components/button.mdx): Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.
- [Button Group](./apps/web/content/docs/components/button-group.mdx): A container that groups related buttons together with consistent styling.
- [Calendar](./apps/web/content/docs/components/calendar.mdx): A date field component that allows users to enter and edit dates.
- [Card](./apps/web/content/docs/components/card.mdx): Displays a card with a header, content, and footer.
- [Carousel](./apps/web/content/docs/components/carousel.mdx): A carousel with motion and swipe built using Embla.
- [Checkbox](./apps/web/content/docs/components/checkbox.mdx): A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.
- [Collapsible](./apps/web/content/docs/components/collapsible.mdx): An interactive component which expands and collapses a panel.
- [Combobox](./apps/web/content/docs/components/combobox.mdx): An input with a list of suggestions that filters as you type.
- [Command](./apps/web/content/docs/components/command.mdx): A fast, composable command menu for React.
- [Context Menu](./apps/web/content/docs/components/context-menu.mdx): Displays a menu of actions triggered by a right click.
- [Dialog](./apps/web/content/docs/components/dialog.mdx): A window overlaid on the page that renders the content underneath inert.
- [Drawer](./apps/web/content/docs/components/drawer.mdx): A drawer component for React, built on Vaul.
- [Dropdown Menu](./apps/web/content/docs/components/dropdown-menu.mdx): Displays a menu of actions or functions, triggered by a button.
- [Empty](./apps/web/content/docs/components/empty.mdx): Displays an empty state, with media, a title, a description, and actions.
- [Field](./apps/web/content/docs/components/field.mdx): Combines labels, controls, and help text into accessible form fields.
- [Hover Card](./apps/web/content/docs/components/hover-card.mdx): For sighted users to preview content available behind a link.
- [Input](./apps/web/content/docs/components/input.mdx): Displays a form input field or a component that looks like an input field.
- [Input Group](./apps/web/content/docs/components/input-group.mdx): Adds addons, buttons, and helper content to inputs.
- [Input OTP](./apps/web/content/docs/components/input-otp.mdx): An accessible one-time password input with copy and paste support.
- [Item](./apps/web/content/docs/components/item.mdx): A versatile row for displaying media, a title, a description, and actions.
- [Kbd](./apps/web/content/docs/components/kbd.mdx): Displays textual user input from a keyboard, such as a shortcut.
- [Label](./apps/web/content/docs/components/label.mdx): Renders an accessible label associated with controls.
- [Menubar](./apps/web/content/docs/components/menubar.mdx): A persistent menu, common in desktop apps, with quick access to a set of commands.
- [Native Select](./apps/web/content/docs/components/native-select.mdx): A styled native HTML select element.
- [Navigation Menu](./apps/web/content/docs/components/navigation-menu.mdx): A collection of links for navigating websites.
- [Pagination](./apps/web/content/docs/components/pagination.mdx): Page navigation with next and previous links.
- [Popover](./apps/web/content/docs/components/popover.mdx): Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.
- [Progress](./apps/web/content/docs/components/progress.mdx): Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task.
- [Radio Group](./apps/web/content/docs/components/radio-group.mdx): A set of checkable buttons where no more than one can be checked at a time.
- [Resizable](./apps/web/content/docs/components/resizable.mdx): Accessible resizable panel groups and layouts with keyboard support.
- [Scroll Area](./apps/web/content/docs/components/scroll-area.mdx): Augments native scroll functionality for custom, cross-browser styling.
- [Select](./apps/web/content/docs/components/select.mdx): Displays a list of options for the user to pick from, triggered by a button.
- [Separator](./apps/web/content/docs/components/separator.mdx): Visually or semantically separates content.
- [Sheet](./apps/web/content/docs/components/sheet.mdx): Extends the dialog to show content that complements the main content of the screen.
- [Sidebar](./apps/web/content/docs/components/sidebar.mdx): A composable, themeable, and customizable sidebar.
- [Skeleton](./apps/web/content/docs/components/skeleton.mdx): Shows a placeholder while content is loading.
- [Slider](./apps/web/content/docs/components/slider.mdx): An input where the user selects a value from within a given range.
- [Sonner](./apps/web/content/docs/components/sonner.mdx): An opinionated toast component for React.
- [Spinner](./apps/web/content/docs/components/spinner.mdx): An indicator that shows a loading state.
- [Switch](./apps/web/content/docs/components/switch.mdx): A control that allows the user to toggle between on and off.
- [Table](./apps/web/content/docs/components/table.mdx): A responsive table component.
- [Tabs](./apps/web/content/docs/components/tabs.mdx): A set of layered sections of content, shown one at a time.
- [Textarea](./apps/web/content/docs/components/textarea.mdx): Displays a form textarea or a component that looks like a textarea.
- [Toggle](./apps/web/content/docs/components/toggle.mdx): A two-state button that can be either on or off.
- [Toggle Group](./apps/web/content/docs/components/toggle-group.mdx): A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off.
- [Tooltip](./apps/web/content/docs/components/tooltip.mdx): A popup that shows information about an element on hover or keyboard focus.

## Cortexcn Components

- [Cortex](./apps/web/content/docs/cortex/index.mdx): Cortexcn originals you won't find in shadcn/ui, for motion, navigation, and theming.
- [Command Search](./apps/web/content/docs/cortex/command-search.mdx): A command palette that types queries and live-filters grouped results, with keyboard navigation.
- [Fan-Out Diagram](./apps/web/content/docs/cortex/fan-out-diagram.mdx): An animated architecture diagram where one source feeds a hub that fans out to many nodes, each with a live status.
- [FAQ Tabs Card](./apps/web/content/docs/cortex/faq-tabs-card.mdx): A tabbed FAQ card with animated accordion answers and a support footer.
- [Gooey Nav](./apps/web/content/docs/cortex/gooey-nav.mdx): A row of links with a filled pill under the active one. Choosing another link sends the pill there like a drop of liquid.
- [Lanyard 3D](./apps/web/content/docs/cortex/lanyard-3d.mdx): A 3D ID badge on a strap. Drag it and it swings and twists on a simulated strap; click it to flip it over.
- [Lanyard Badge](./apps/web/content/docs/cortex/lanyard-badge.mdx): An ID badge hanging from a strap. Drag it and it swings back on a simulated rope; click it to flip it over.
- [Line Nav](./apps/web/content/docs/cortex/line-nav.mdx): Vertical navigation with a line marker that expands on hover and active state.
- [Logos Carousel](./apps/web/content/docs/cortex/logos-carousel.mdx): Cycle through logos column by column in a staggered wave.
- [Marquee](./apps/web/content/docs/cortex/marquee.mdx): An infinite scrolling component that can be used to display text, images, or videos.
- [Number Ticker](./apps/web/content/docs/cortex/number-ticker.mdx): A rolling digit ticker that counts to a value with per-digit stagger, padding, and blur.
- [Perspective Marquee](./apps/web/content/docs/cortex/perspective-marquee.mdx): A tilted wall of images that scrolls endlessly in alternating columns.
- [Sphere Menu](./apps/web/content/docs/cortex/sphere-menu.mdx): A sphere of image tiles you can spin in any direction. When it slows down, the nearest tile turns to face you and its link appears.
- [Theme Toggle Effect](./apps/web/content/docs/cortex/theme-toggle-effect.mdx): Animated transitions when switching between light and dark themes.
- [Work Experience](./apps/web/content/docs/cortex/work-experience.mdx): Display work experiences with role details, company logos, and durations.

## Backgrounds

- [Backgrounds](./apps/web/content/docs/backgrounds/index.mdx): Animated full-bleed backgrounds for heroes and sections, drawn with WebGL.
- [Light Speed](./apps/web/content/docs/backgrounds/light-speed.mdx): A warp-speed tunnel of glowing light streaks, drawn with three.js and bloom.

## Charts

- [Charts](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/index.mdx): Composable charts with animation, tooltips, and themes.
- [Area Chart](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/area-chart.mdx): A composable area chart with gradient fills, tooltips, and hover interactions
- [Bar Chart](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/bar-chart.mdx): A composable bar chart with spring animations, stacked bars, horizontal orientation, and grouped series support
- [Candlestick Chart](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/candlestick-chart.mdx): A composable OHLC candlestick chart with gradients, patterns, tooltips, and hover interactions
- [Choropleth Chart](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/choropleth-chart.mdx): A composable geographic map chart for visualizing data across regions with interactive tooltips, zoom controls, and pattern support
- [Composed Chart](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/composed-chart.mdx): Mix SeriesBar, Line, and Area on one shared time axis (Recharts ComposedChart–style)
- [Funnel Chart](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/funnel-chart.mdx): An animated funnel chart with multi-layer halo rings, hover interactions, and staggered entrance animations
- [Gauge](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/gauge-chart.mdx): Notch-based radial or linear gauge with optional center label, theme fills, patterns, arc gradients, and responsive sizing
- [Heatmap Chart](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/heatmap-chart.mdx): A contribution heatmap with animated cells, configurable level colors and patterns, and an interactive legend
- [Line Chart](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/line-chart.mdx): A composable line chart with tooltips, markers, and hover interactions
- [Profit/Loss Line](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/profit-loss-line.mdx): Sign-colored line segments for profit and loss on a shared zero baseline
- [Live Line Chart](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/live-line-chart.mdx): Real-time streaming line chart with smooth scrolling, crosshair, and animated axes
- [Pie Chart](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/pie-chart.mdx): A composable pie and donut chart with animated slices, hover interactions, patterns, gradients, and an interactive legend
- [Radar Chart](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/radar-chart.mdx): A composable multi-series radar chart with animated polygons, hover interactions, and customizable metrics
- [Ring Chart](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/ring-chart.mdx): A composable multi-ring progress chart with animated arcs, hover interactions, and a reusable legend component
- [Scatter Chart](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/scatter-chart.mdx): A composable time-series scatter chart with offset rings, hover dimming, and animated enter
- [Sankey Chart](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/sankey-chart.mdx): A composable sankey diagram for visualizing flow between nodes with animated links and interactive tooltips
- [Sunburst Chart](./apps/web/content/docs/charts/sunburst-chart.mdx): A composable hierarchical sunburst chart with drill-down zoom, animated segments, breadcrumb navigation, and legend sync

## Chart Utilities

- [Legend](./apps/web/content/docs/utility/legend.mdx): A composable legend component for charts with progress bars, markers, and customizable layouts
- [Grid](./apps/web/content/docs/utility/grid.mdx): A customizable grid component for charts with horizontal and vertical lines, edge fade, edge line hiding, and dashed styling
- [Background](./apps/web/content/docs/utility/background.mdx): Pattern fill for the plot area when grid lines are hidden, with presets, an edge fade, and an enter animation
- [Reference Area](./apps/web/content/docs/utility/reference-area.mdx): Shaded Y band for target ranges and thresholds on cartesian charts, with a solid or pattern fill, dashed edges, and Y-axis tick coloring
- [Projection Line](./apps/web/content/docs/utility/projection-line.mdx): Forecast segment extending a line series past the last data point, with a dashed stroke, a gradient, and a horizon marker
- [Tooltip](./apps/web/content/docs/utility/tooltip.mdx): An interactive tooltip component for charts with crosshair, dots, date picker, and customizable content
- [Brush](./apps/web/content/docs/utility/brush.mdx): Time-range brush for zooming area and line charts with a mini-chart strip and draggable selection handles
- [Axis](./apps/web/content/docs/utility/axis/index.mdx): X and Y axis components for line and area charts
- [X Axis](./apps/web/content/docs/utility/axis/x-axis.mdx): Date labels for the horizontal axis in line and area charts
- [Y Axis](./apps/web/content/docs/utility/axis/y-axis.mdx): Value labels for the vertical axis in line and area charts
- [useChart Hook](./apps/web/content/docs/utility/use-chart.mdx): Access chart state and context for building custom chart components
- [Custom Indicator](./apps/web/content/docs/utility/custom-indicator.mdx): Create custom tooltip indicators for charts using the useChart hook

## AI Integration

- [MCP Server](./apps/web/content/docs/integration/mcp.mdx): Connect your AI assistant to Cortexcn so it can search, read, and install components, blocks, and charts.
- [Skills](./apps/web/content/docs/integration/skills.mdx): Agent skills that teach your AI assistant how to find, install, and style Cortexcn components, blocks, and charts.
- [DESIGN.md](./apps/web/content/docs/integration/design-md.mdx): Cortexcn's design system as a DESIGN.md file your AI assistant can read and follow.
